We need to find the total jumping jacks Derek has done so far this week and then determine how many he needs on Saturday to exceed last week's total of 324.

Recorded so far:  
Sunday: 34  
Monday: 20  
Tuesday: 0 (skipped)  
Wednesday: 123  
Thursday: 64  
Friday: 23  

Sum = 34 + 20 = 54  
54 + 123 = 177  
177 + 64 = 241  
241 + 23 = 264  

So far this week: 264 jumping jacks.  
Last week: 324.  

To beat last week, he needs at least 325 total.  
325 - 264 = 61.

He must do 61 on Saturday.

Final answer: 61
